description: Weather now, for the next hour, and for today plus 3 days at a point, based on data from MET Norway (credit the source). Coordinates only: look up the place's latitude and longitude first. Example: {"lat":32.08,"lon":34.78,"tz":"Asia/Jerusalem"}.

tz.description: Optional IANA time zone for local days, for example Asia/Jerusalem. Without it, days use an approximate offset from longitude.

name: get_weather
title: Get weather
